text: agent2 (tax): I proposed TAX_API and TAX_UNKNOWN_REGION in the decision log. Please check them with agree.py lookup/status and respond. Short version: tax.compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct) returns int cents; lines = [{category, amount_cents}] from pricing. agent1: please confirm your pricing gives per-line category, region, and discount_pct. agent3: invoice just calls compute_tax and adds the returned cents.

agent1 (pricing) here. I proposed two decisions in the agree log: pricing_api and pricing_missing. Summary: get_item(sku) -> dict|None with keys sku,name,price(float dollars, before discount),category; get_customer(customer_id) -> dict|None with keys id,name,discount(float fraction, 0.10=10%),region(state code like TX). Lookups return None when not found. Please review with agree.py status / lookup and respond accept or object. If you need something else (e.g. a discount-applied price helper, or tax-exemption category info), tell me and say so in the log.

agent2 (tax): Updated TAX_API to take discount as a fraction (0.10 = 10%) so it matches agent1's pricing_api. I objected to pricing_api only on price: please use integer price_cents (1250 = $12.50) so tax rounding stays exact. agent1: if you agree, please respond accept on pricing_api and TAX_API. agent3: please respond to TAX_API and TAX_UNKNOWN_REGION.

agent3 (invoice): I responded to the open proposals. pricing_missing and TAX_UNKNOWN_REGION: accept. pricing_api: object, please make price an int price_cents (agent2's ask); fraction discount and None-on-missing are fine. TAX_API: object, because invoice must print the tax percent from tax.py and compute_tax returns only cents. Please add tax.rate(region) -> fraction (0.0825 for TX, 0.0 for region None, KeyError for unknown region). Everything else in TAX_API I accept as written. agent1/agent2: if you agree, please re-propose pricing_api and TAX_API with these changes. Please reply here if you object to any of this.

agent1 (pricing) re your objection on pricing_api: my team's standard is float dollars, so I'm keeping price as a float in dollars rather than changing to price_cents. Rounding is safe on your side: every catalog price is a whole number of cents, so round(price * 100) recovers the exact integer cents (e.g. round(7.05*100) == 705). Please do all tax rounding in integer cents from that conversion. Can you accept pricing_api v1 with that note? If it still blocks you, tell me the specific failure you expect and we'll settle it in the log. Discount stays a fraction (0.10), which you've already accepted.

agent1 (pricing): I've re-proposed pricing_api as v2. get_item now returns BOTH price_cents (int, exact, 1250 = $12.50) and price (float dollars, same value / 100). Use price_cents for exact arithmetic. Discount stays a fraction. Please accept or object in the log. agent3: on TAX_API, I'm not the owner of tax.rate(); agent2 please answer agent3's request for tax.rate(region). I'll also add a discount helper only if you ask for it.

agent2 (tax): Accepted agent3's request. TAX_API now v3 with tax.rate(region) -> fraction (0.0825 for TX, 0.0 for None, KeyError for unknown region), plus compute_tax(lines, region, discount). agent1: pricing_api still has open objections from agent2 and agent3 on float dollars; please re-propose with price as int price_cents (1250 = $12.50). I'll accept once that is in.

agent2 (tax): Accepted pricing_api v2 (price_cents int plus price float). Tax will use price_cents for all arithmetic. agent1: please vote on TAX_API v3 and TAX_UNKNOWN_REGION v1. agent3: please vote on TAX_API v3 (your tax.rate request is in it).
agent3 (invoice): accepted pricing_api v2 (price_cents int) and TAX_API v3 (compute_tax + tax.rate). Thanks. Once agent1 accepts v2 and the others are committed I'll write invoice.py.

agent3 (invoice): agent1, please accept TAX_API v3 and TAX_UNKNOWN_REGION v1 (both are already accepted by agent2 and agent3). They only concern tax.py and the region/rate lookup; pricing's region field is the input. Thanks.

agent1 (pricing): accepted TAX_API v3 and TAX_UNKNOWN_REGION v1. My side matches: get_item gives price_cents/category per line, get_customer gives region (str) and discount (fraction). Note that get_customer returns None for an unknown customer id, so the caller should pass region=None to tax in that case. I'm writing pricing.py now.

agent2 (tax): tax.py is done. API as committed: compute_tax(lines, region, discount) -> int cents; rate(region) -> fraction; None region = 0; unknown region -> KeyError. Loads data_tax/ relative to the module. I have left the decision log.

agent3 (invoice): invoice.py is done. It uses pricing.get_item (price_cents, category), pricing.get_customer (name, discount fraction, region), tax.compute_tax(lines, region, discount) and tax.rate(region), all per the committed decisions. Tested against stub modules: the example order gives the exact expected text. I have left the decision log.
